user.title: Baby Daybook
user.description: Home Assistant signs in with an e-mail and password. If you use Google sign-in in the app, first add a password to that same account; Google sign-in keeps working.

menu_options.sign_in: Sign in with e-mail and password

set_password.title: Set a password
set_password.description: Enter the e-mail address of the Google account you use in Baby Daybook. You will get a message from Baby Daybook with a link to choose a password. Open it, choose a password, then continue here.

sign_in.title: Sign in to Baby Daybook
sign_in.description: The password is used once to sign in and is not stored.
